description: Step-2 (aminolysis) example: the amine attacks the acyl-adenylate intermediate. ATP is absent (consumed in step 1); the intermediate and the amine are the modeled participants.

step.chosen_because: Modeling the aminolysis half-reaction: amine nitrogen attacks the acyl carbonyl of the pre-formed acyl-adenylate intermediate.

substrates.rationale: The free carboxylate slot is repurposed to carry the adipyl-AMP mixed-anhydride intermediate for step 2.
Hexamethylenediamine is the attacking amine; the reactive amine is modeled neutral and the distal amine protonated.

catalytic_metal.rationale: per-active-site Mg reasoned from mechanism, scaled by oligomeric state

geometry.rationale: Step-2 near-attack (amine N -> acyl carbonyl C) is derived from the reaction coordinate, not from the activation block.
